en.title: Version 1.3.2
en.content:
**Development dependencies and CI**
- Update PHPStan from 2.3.5 to 2.3.7 and resolve the dynamic-price provider once so the scheduled import passes static analysis and still defaults to ENTSO-E.
- Update PHPUnit from 13.4.6 to 13.4.8, including upstream fixes for failure reporting when a test class is skipped, test baselines and JUnit output.
